name: Fiddlehead
description: An endless dive into a self-similar fern: every frond is lined with smaller copies of itself, and each one unfurls as the camera reaches it. The fern glows in a stained-glass colour bath that flows down its branches; bass swells the light riding the colour bands, treble glitters on the leaflet edges, the passage's loudness sets the exposure, and every beat on the cached beat grid sends a nerve impulse from the trunk out to the leaflet tips, downbeats stronger. Rendered by a compute descent; this fragment is only the dark ground shown while its fields bake.
author: Uzume engine
